profile.headline: Software Engineer @ MSFT | CS Northwestern ‘26 | NU Posse Scholar, HSF Scholar
profile.summary: Hello! My name is Michael Hernandez-Thomas and I am a FGLI graduate of Computer Science from Northwestern University. My career interests lie in the fields of Machine Learning/AI, Robotics, Virtual/Augmented Reality, Quantum Computing, Business, and Education. I highly value connection and community, and strive to create a positive impact for the world and those around me. My hobbies and other interests include music, fashion, fitness, and the beach!
